title: One Picture Book Two Vol 56: Total Football

description.main: A companion to Giulia Iacolutti's I Don't Care (About Football), with mostly unpublished photographs and collages made with the Marangoni 105 football team in Udine.
description.extended:
A companion to Giulia Iacolutti's I Don't Care (About Football), with mostly unpublished photographs and collages made with the Marangoni 105 football team in Udine.

The team plays out of a rehabilitation residence run by the Duemilauno Agenzia Sociale cooperative, part of Udine's Mental Health Department. Iacolutti developed the work there through workshops in photography, writing, and collective art-making, treating football as a place for participation and care. The title borrows Johan Cruyff's "total football", a fluid, collective way of playing, and every player wears Cruyff's number 14. The book has 11 duotone plates. It is number 56 in Nazraeli Press's One Picture Book Two series, made in collaboration with Micamera in an edition of 500 numbered copies, each with a signed 5x7 inch print.

Iacolutti (b. 1985, Italy) works with photography, moving image, performance, and participatory practice, on vulnerability and collective agency. Her books include Casa Azul (the(M) éditions and studiofaganel, 2019) and I Don't Care (About Football) (bruno, 2023), which was shortlisted for the Author Book Award at Les Rencontres d'Arles.
